acceptanceCriteria: Every listed file appears in exactly one shard.
The same inputs give the same partition and digest.
Weights are the median of the last K retained full runs; K is configurable.
Files with no history use the median weight and are flagged.
Invalid or missing history falls back to a complete round-robin, and the fallback is reported.
The output feeds the existing sharded stability and compare flow, which fails closed on a missing shard.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1022 (owner, 2026-10-17). Fixed or directory shards finish far apart. Proposal: a planner such as 'tests shards --count N' takes the listed test files plus retained run durations, assigns longest-first to the lightest shard using the median of the last K retained full runs, gives unknown files the median weight (flagged), records a partition digest, and falls back to complete round-robin (reported) on invalid or missing history. Output feeds the existing sharded stability/compare flow, which fails closed on a missing shard.
title: tests shards: duration-balanced deterministic shard partition from retained run history (GitHub #1022)
